title: Admin Playbook and Support Macros for RBAC v2, Audit Logging, and SSO
creator: Priya Raman
description: Deliver a pragmatic admin playbook and set of support macros to enable SRE, Support, and SOC teams to operate RBAC v2 during rollout. Includes runbook steps for audit log verification, SSO/SAML IdP mapping checks, escalation paths, dry-run checklist, and canned responses for support engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Admin playbook published in Confluence with step-by-step runbook and rollback instructions
Support macros added to Zendesk macros library and validated in staging
End-to-end dry-run of RBAC v2 > SSO mapping > audit log generation performed and documented
At least two on-call SREs reviewed and signed off on escalation/playbook steps
Automated smoke query for recent audit log entries added to Console observability dashboard

support_macros: Macro: RBAC-V2-Access-Check — 'Hi {customer}, I’ve run an access check for {user_email} against role {role}. Result: {allowed|denied}. If denied, please confirm the IdP group mappings and provide the user's SAML NameID. Next steps: (1) If mapping missing, update IdP group -> Redwood role mapping. (2) If mapping exists, request a SSO relogin and allow 60s for cache propagation.'

Macro: RBAC-V2-Revoke-Session — 'Hi {customer}, I initiated a session revoke for {user_email}. Expected propagation: ~30-90s. Please ask the user to sign out and sign back in. Confirm once they are able to access the expected resources. If access persists unexpectedly, escalate to on-call SRE with logs: <link to audit query>.'

Macro: RBAC-V2-Audit-Request — 'Hi {customer}, to investigate this permission change we need the timestamp window and affected resources. We will pull audit events for role grants/revokes and IdP assertions. Typical turnaround: 1–2 business days. If urgent, escalate with the subject: [URGENT RBAC ACCESS] and include Admin contact.'
observability_checklist: Verify audit events stream to secure S3 bucket (or customer-managed endpoint) within 5 minutes
Confirm 'role.grant' and 'role.revoke' events include admin_id, actor_ip, idp_assertion_id, and preceding request_id
Add Console smoke query for 24h delta of unexpected grants (>3 events for same resource)
Instrument alert: 'audit-log-ingest-failure' with pager duty if ingestion delay > 10m
rollback_plan: If a rollout causes customer-facing mis-authorizations: (1) Toggle feature flag 'rbac_v2_migration' to 'off' to stop staged mappings from applying, (2) Run bulk reconciliation job to reapply RBAC v1 mappings from snapshot (location: s3://rbac-migration/snapshots/2025-02-XX), (3) Inform affected customers via support macro and open a postmortem task (ENG-xxxx).
final_notes: Focus on operator ergonomics: short clear macros, checklists for timing windows (SSO propagation and cache TTLs), and a low-friction audit workflow so support can produce reproducible artifacts for security and engineering. After rollout, plan a 30-day review to capture migration anomalies and update playbook.
